name: Jelena Petrović
bio:
Jelena's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, fueled by a lifelong fascination with complex systems and a chance encounter with a racing engineer at a university career fair. Prior to this, she was excelling in advanced statistics, but felt her talents could be better used to chase a more dynamic goal. Intrigued, she immersed herself in data analytics courses, focusing on applications within the racing world.

Her approach to data analysis is meticulous and innovative. Jelena thrives on uncovering hidden patterns and leveraging data to optimize performance. While relatively new to the field, she is a quick learner and is keen on learning more about the world of motorsport. She believes that a fresh perspective and dedication can yield significant improvements, even in a data-saturated environment.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Jelena is of average height with an athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down sudden ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee.
